findings.issue: `hasSum_stdPeterWeyl_expansion` sums against `stdPeterWeylBasis 𝕜 G x`, while the parallel `hasSum_peterWeyl_expansion` (line 523) sums against `peterWeylFamily models x`; since `coe_stdPeterWeylBasis` is `@[simp]`, the std statement is not in simp-normal form, so a simp-normalized goal will not match it.

summary: The new `peterWeylCoeff` definition ships with no unfolding lemma and no unconditional characterization, so the Haar integral it exists to expose is invisible downstream and every fact about it is gated behind `IsAlgClosed` plus a skeleton. The unconditional expansion lemma is also stated in a non-parallel, non-simp-normal form.
